maximum_depth_rule: All 16 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once. The nine policy-evaluation rows and seven KPI-direction rows remain separate source roles and are not interpreted as one time series.
version_boundary: The 2020 to 2024 initial-plan evaluation and the 2025 to 2029 second-phase plan remain separate versions. Population goals, policy KPIs, annual KPI materials, and administrative evaluation remain separate layers.
non_goals: Do not infer records for the four registered documents with zero reviewed rows.
Do not attach prior-plan final results automatically to second-phase targets.
Do not split mixed hierarchy, evaluation, and KPI-direction text into inferred actual and target fields.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
